I have farmed this land for many years, so I will plant the local yam and cassava varieties I kept from last season because they grow well here and do not need expensive inputs. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer or those new seeds from the agro-dealer, and besides, tubers do not need them like maize does. My family will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves because the plot is small enough to manage without hiring laborers. I will not spray any chemicals or irrigate since the rains will come soon and these crops have always done fine with what God provides.
